title: Cooling Fan "B" Power Circuit /Open
shortDescription: PCM detected: cooling Fan "B" Power Circuit /Open.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates cooling Fan "B" Power Circuit /Open. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: May cause overheating in heavy load; monitor coolant temp.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect cooling fan B circuit wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect cooling fan B circuit and clear codes.

faq.a: Short distances are usually fine; avoid heavy load.
Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.

title: Manual Shift Detection Switch Circuit
shortDescription: PCM detected: manual Shift Detection Switch Circuit.
fullDescription:
This DTC indicates manual Shift Detection Switch Circuit. The PCM monitors related signals against learned thresholds and stores the code when the fault matures.

Ignoring it can lead to driveability issues, increased emissions, or progressive component damage.
safetyImpact: Manual mode unavailable; automatic mode unaffected.

fixSteps.title: Scan and capture freeze frame
fixSteps.instruction: Read all stored and pending codes; record freeze-frame data.

fixSteps.title: Visual inspection
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect manual shift detection switch wiring, connectors and related components for damage.

fixSteps.title: Electrical test
fixSteps.instruction: Verify reference, ground, and signal at the affected connector with engine running.

fixSteps.title: Replace component
fixSteps.instruction: If circuit checks pass, replace the suspect manual shift detection switch and clear codes.

Rare - the PCM needs a verified passing drive cycle to clear.
